motivation: The completed environmental tests targeted equal-species mean effects. A mean near zero can coexist with strong positive and negative species-specific coupling. This analysis tests heterogeneity itself rather than attempting to rescue a positive global mean.

fixed_features.selection_rule: all previously frozen parent features are included; no feature is added, dropped or privileged because of its observed mean p-value

geometry_and_species_effects.main_effect_species_statistic: same distance-controlled partial Spearman rho used in the completed five-block panel, with the parent panel's >=5 retained-edge species rule
geometry_and_species_effects.interaction_species_statistic: same beta_AxB used in the completed ten-pair family, including geographic distance and both additive main effects, with the parent's >=20 retained-edge/full-rank design rule
geometry_and_species_effects.missing_environment_rule: unchanged pair/block-specific complete cases; no missing value becomes zero

main_effect_variance.observed_statistic: sample variance (ddof=1) across the 369 species partial-rho estimates for each complete process block
main_effect_variance.null_statistic: same variance across species under each of the exact 999 shared RGFCA colour permutations
main_effect_variance.multiplicity: Holm across exactly the five parent blocks

interaction_variance.observed_statistic: sample variance (ddof=1) across the 369 species beta_AxB estimates for each complete interaction pair
interaction_variance.null_statistic: same variance across species under each of the exact 999 shared RGFCA colour permutations
interaction_variance.multiplicity: Holm across exactly the ten interaction pairs

statistics.matrix: 369 species x all five main-effect estimates
statistics.statistic: largest eigenvalue of the 5x5 species correlation matrix divided by 5

statistics.matrix: 369 species x five main effects plus all ten interaction effects
statistics.statistic: largest eigenvalue of the 15x15 species correlation matrix divided by 15

coordinated_syndrome_omnibus.null: For each exact colour permutation index, recompute the complete species-effect matrix and the same PC1-fraction statistic. Shared null index across all features preserves dependence created by common colour permutations and correlated environmental predictors.
coordinated_syndrome_omnibus.multiplicity: Holm across the two omnibus syndrome statistics

null.operation: same within-species complete flower-colour-vector permutation used by RGFCA and both parent environmental families

interpretation.supported_feature_variance: Species differ in the strength/sign of association with that broad process more than expected from the frozen colour-permutation null. This is evidence of heterogeneity, not of a positive mean effect.
interpretation.supported_pc1_omnibus: The multi-feature species response matrix has stronger coordinated low-dimensional structure than expected under the shared colour null, consistent with recurrent species-response syndromes.
interpretation.unsupported: No permutation-supported excess heterogeneity/syndrome is established for that family/statistic.
interpretation.thermal_dryness: Thermal and atmospheric/dryness are never tested as a privileged pair; any relationship is interpreted only inside the complete five/15-feature structures.

claim_ceiling: Exploratory permutation evidence may support cross-species heterogeneity or coordinated response syndromes in broad environmental colour associations. It cannot establish causal selection, local adaptation, a universal direction, or rescue any completed mean-effect family.
